user.title: Select a rocker
user.description: Select a nearby SWBD rocker. Close the manufacturer app and disconnect other BLE gateways.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot read rocker state. Check Bluetooth range and disconnect the manufacturer app or another gateway.

abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not supported.
abort.no_devices_found: No SWBD rockers found. Turn on the rocker and check that Home Assistant has a working Bluetooth adapter within range.
